subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 4: WOW! Book Club – An adventure story
outcomes: Know the features of an adventure story: characters, setting and exciting events.
Understand the events of the story Old-fashioned explorers.
Make and use compound adjectives like ice-cold and world-famous.

tf.s: In a story, a character is a person.
tf.why: Yes, characters are the people in the story.

tf.s: The setting of a story is the place where it happens.
tf.why: Correct! The setting is the place.

tf.s: An adventure story usually has boring events.
Nada brought her grandad’s old compass.
tf.why: Right! She took Grandad’s old compass.

tf.s: Hussain heard a man who was shouting for help.
tf.why: Yes, Hussain heard the man’s shouts.

tf.s: The man fell into a river.
tf.why: The man fell down the cliff.

tf.s: The people in the helicopter pulled the man to safety on a rope.
tf.why: Great! Then they took him to hospital.

tf.s: Old-fashioned explorers had mobile phones and helicopters.
tf.why: They didn’t have mobile phones or helicopters to help people.

tf.s: We make a compound adjective with word + hyphen + word, like ice-cold.
“World-famous” means only a few people know it.
tf.why: World-famous means people all over the world know it.

boxes.q: What did Nada bring with her?
Make a compound adjective: ice + cold
Food you make at home is ___ food.
A journey that takes nine hours is a ___ journey.
boxes.why: In compound adjectives the noun is singular: nine-hour.

boxes.q: A country where people speak English is an ___ country.
A book that won a prize is a ___ book.
boxes.why: Prize-winning means it won a prize.

boxes.q: The place where a story happens is the…
Who heard the man shouting for help?
What helped the man get to hospital?
boxes.why: The helicopter team took him to hospital.

hunt.q: It took the man to hospital

mcq.q: Which is a feature of an adventure story?
o: It is a list of facts.

mcq.q: Who are the three children in the story?
mcq.why: The journalist role play interviews Hussain, Rahaf and Nada.

mcq.q: How did the people in the helicopter help the man?
o: They pulled him to safety on a rope and took him to hospital.
They took him home on a camel.

mcq.q: How do we make a compound adjective?
o: two words with no hyphen ever

mcq.q: Complete: “After the long walk, we drank some ___ water.”

mcq.why: Bread made at home is home-made.

mcq.q: Why are the children happy that they aren’t really old-fashioned explorers?
o: Old-fashioned explorers didn’t have mobile phones or helicopters to help people.
mcq.why: Modern tools like helicopters can save people.

o: Hussain heard a man shouting for help.
The man was taken to hospital.
The helicopter pulled the man up on a rope.
The helicopter flew away with the man.
mcq.why: Hearing the shouts came before the rescue.

mcq.q: Why do we say “a nine-hour journey” and not “a nine-hours journey”?
o: In a compound adjective the noun stays singular.
mcq.why: Compound adjectives before a noun don’t take -s.
